description: Lists the notification channels of the account (confirmed emails, linked Telegram and MAX chats, work chats — `type: chat_webhook` with the chat in `provider`: Mattermost, Rocket.Chat, Pachca, Discord, Slack — and confirmed phones for outage calls, `type: phone`) together with whether this project uses them. A phone switched on here is called only while voice calls are on in the project, see `project_voice_calls_get`. A channel is connected once for the whole account; a project only switches it on or off for its own monitoring notifications. Account-level notifications — invoices, security, API keys — reach every channel regardless of this setting. Webhooks are not here: their scope is stored on the subscription, see `webhook_update`. A work chat with `is_disabled_by_plan: true` receives nothing on the current plan; its on/off state in projects is kept and applies again after an upgrade. A Telegram or MAX channel with a non-null `disabled_reason` receives nothing either, even when switched on here: the messenger refuses delivery until the chat is fixed and a channel test in the Statuser panel succeeds.
name: project_channel_list
title: List channels of a project
